name: MOS Technology KIM-1
description: KIM-1 profile using original 6530-002 and 6530-003 ROM dumps. Requires later implementation of KIM-1 6530 I/O, keypad and 7-segment LED devices for full monitor usability.

rom.description: Original verified 6530-003 ROM dump, mapped at $1800-$1BFF

devices.description: Placeholder for KIM-1 6530 RAM/I/O/timer behavior. Needed for real KIM-1 monitor interaction. Exact register map must be implemented in code.
Six-digit seven-segment display device used by KIM-1 front panel.
KIM-1 hexadecimal keypad/front panel input device.

notes: Use filler byte 00 ROM dumps for emulation, not assembler-rebuilt FF filler versions.
This profile can load ROMs now, but KIM-1 monitor interaction requires 6530 I/O device support.
